Grandma's Tomato Soup

Serves 4. Prep time: 10 minutes.

You will need

  • 6 ripe tomatoes
  • 1 onion
    • diced finely
  • 2 cups vegetable stock

Method

Chop the tomatoes.
Simmer everything for 20 minutes.
